PreToolUse.command: if ! command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 0; fi; tool_name=$(jq -r '.tool_name // empty'); command_text=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if [ "$tool_name" = "run_in_terminal" ] && printf '%s' "$command_text" | grep -Eq '(^|[;&|[:space:]])git[[:space:]]+(reset|clean|checkout|restore|branch[[:space:]]+-D)([[:space:]]|$)|(^|[;&|[:space:]])git[[:space:]]+push([^;&|]*[[:space:]])?--force([[:space:]]|$)'; then printf '%s\n' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"This command may discard Git history or working-tree changes. Confirm before running it."}}'; fi
